comparisons.name: switches-light
comparisons.description: The card of switches at the top of the Today view, Aqua, over the panel colours measured around it. Masked: the text, set in the fallback font off Apple platforms (row labels) and the two glyphs, which are Apple artwork.

comparisons.name: switches-dark
comparisons.description: The card of switches at the top of the Today view, Dark Aqua, over the panel colours measured around it. Masked: the text, set in the fallback font off Apple platforms (row labels) and the two glyphs, which are Apple artwork.

comparisons.name: header-light
comparisons.description: A widget's header band and body on the panel colour over the sky, Aqua. The colours are the card's tokens composited over that colour; the tokens are fitted to the switches card and the notification, whose band is the same.

pixels.note: header band: the header tint over the card fill over the panel colour, computed from the tokens (measured on the notification's band: #d3eef8, #11213a)
body: the card fill over the panel colour, computed from the tokens (measured on the switches card: #dcf5ff, #12233c)
the panel colour beside the card, which is 322 pt wide
